scope: Ordered TDD fixes B1–B4; no connected Demo changes or deployment

B1.behavior: Rollback local pre-intent admission; mark durable write attempts for fenced rejection; refuse to rewrite acknowledged/conflicting recorder history

B2.behavior: Share one remaining order reservation across all known future debits; preserve positive future cash until maturity without anticipating sell credits

B3.behavior: Publish funding template discovery only after successful load; transient errors and cancellation remain retryable; empty/missing catalogues remain read-only

B4.behavior: Weak references retain no-transport proof for the exact live rejected object; retired objects release IDs; replacement objects require exchange readback
B4.notes: First native Green attempt exposed an invalid MagicMock fixture, corrected then both failures reconfirmed against unchanged baseline before final Green
